title_sq: Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, tek Pallati me Shigjeta!
description_sq:
Apartamenti eshte i tipologjise 2+1+2 me nje siperfaqe bruto prej 105 m2 dhe neto 94m2. 
I organizuar ne nje dhome ndenje me kend gatimi te vecuar dhe tavoline ngrenie, 2 dhoma gjumi nje prej te cilave matrimoniale me tualet dhe ballkon dhe nje tualet dite. 
Kendi i gatimit ka ajrim dhe ndricim natyral dhe elektoshtepiake te cilsesiese me te larte. 
Te dyja tualetet jane me ajrim natyral. 
Apartamenti ka nje kaldaje te dedikuar me panel diellor ne tarracen e pallatit e cila eshte mjaft ekonomike per ngrohje gjate stines se dimrit. 
Apartamenti eshte i investuar ne detaje me arkitet para 3 vitesh me nje investim prej 60.000 euro 
Orientimi i apartamentit eshte jug perendim, orientim i cili ofron ngrohtesi dhe ndricim natyral. 
Nje apartament me komoditet, cilesi dhe ndjesine e qetesise te ngrohte e familjare. 
Apartamenti eshte i rivlersuar ne vitin 2022. 
Per me shume informacion apo nje vizite ne prone, me kontaktoni!!
title_en: Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, in Palati me Šjetje!
description_en: The apartment is of the 2+1+2 typology with a gross area of ​​105 m2 and a net area of ​​94 m2. Organized in a living room with a separate kitchen corner and dining table, 2 bedrooms, one of which is a double bedroom with a bathroom and a balcony, and a day toilet. The kitchen area has natural ventilation and lighting and the highest quality household appliances. Both toilets have natural ventilation. The apartment has a dedicated boiler with a solar panel on the terrace of the building, which is quite economical for heating during the winter season. The apartment was invested in details with an architect 3 years ago with an investment of 60,000 euros. The orientation of the apartment is south-west, which provides warmth and natural lighting. An apartment with comfort, quality and the feeling of warm and family calm. The apartment is re-evaluated in 2022. For more information or a visit to the property, contact me!!
